When I first came here I assumed it was just a small cafe with a few tables inside, instead what I found was a lovely boutique and cafe with a huge garden back patio! Simply fantastic.

The food is typical morning bakery items and some hot dishes. I like to stick with a bagel or avocado toast. They also have breakfast burritos and sandwiches. I thought those were just okay but otherwise any bakery food has been great. A huge assortment of teas and coffees. Easy to please any guest.

From my experience the service has always been great and friendly. You order at the counter and any food items they'll bring to your table. I feel like the service is super quick here, I've never had to wait long for food and the outside is so spacious that even when they get busy they can fit many.

My other favorite thing about this spot is their small store/boutique on the inside. They always have the cutest little dishtowels! There the secret is out. Love all of the small home and garden goods. A great little treat to be able to shop while brunching."},{"review_date":"2021-10-21 19:43:17","review_stars":3.0,"review_text":"I don't understand the hype. Most of their sandwiches/food items are average. Their California ciabatta super disappoints. Something about they way they make the egg or the type of cheese they use. The bread is not a good choice for it either. Plus, they are never very friendly and I've been there probably 5-10 times now."},{"review_date":"2021-09-20 22:43:48","review_stars":5.0,"review_text":"The very best sandwiches we've ever had!!!!!
A beautiful garden to eat your lunch in also 
Just can't say enough about this hidden gem. 
Found it accidentally while looking for the old Santa Claus lane I remembered as a child which is no longer there. 
You won't be disappointed with these delicious freshly made foods"}],"state":"CA"}

The Garden Market is a business located in Carpinteria, CA that offers delis, restaurants, grocery, American (New) cuisine, cafes, coffee & tea, beer, wine & spirits, and food. It is open Monday through Sunday from 8am to 4pm. The Garden Market has free WiFi and takes out orders, making it a great spot for groups. The cafe has outdoor seating, allowing guests to enjoy their meals in a peaceful setting.

According to customer reviews, the restaurant offers typical breakfast items such as bagels, avocado toast, and breakfast burritos. However, its California ciabatta sandwich has received mixed reviews, with some customers finding it disappointing. Some customers also report that the service can be slow.

<<CARNOT_FOCUS_START:713:1097>>One customer highly praised the business, calling it a hidden gem and one of the very best sandwiches they've ever had. Another customer expressed disappointment with the food and the service, stating that the restaurant does not live up to the hype. Overall, the Garden Market appears to be a casual eatery that offers a variety of options for a tasty and relaxing brunch experience.<<CARNOT_FOCUS_END>>
